objective: V4.0 — Spark Lanes: make sparks the core memory unit and route memory through human-use lanes, trust states, and lane-aware retrieval.
context: V3.9.12 proves the portable context terminal loop. V4.0 is the memory architecture release: raw logs are receipts, episodic summaries are anchors, sparks are future-use compression, patterns emerge from reused sparks, and canon remains manually reviewed high-trust truth.
decisions: Primary lanes are learning, work, relationships, money, health, operating_style
Every spark has one primary lane, optional domain/tags, why_keep, worth reason, confidence, sensitivity, and trust state
Retrieval chooses lane/scope before broad fallback
Sensitive lanes default to candidate/review and never auto-promote to canon
Existing memory_items remain readable through migration/backward compatibility
External collectors are later optional inputs, not the V4 core
non_goals: Calendar/filesystem/git collectors as the core V4 deliverable
risks: Rigid lanes could misclassify domain drift
Loose lanes could become fake tags and fail to protect retrieval
Sensitive relationship, money, and health memories require careful trust defaults
Migration must not break existing retrieval or UI memory filters
qa_expectations: CROWLEY_TEST_MODE=1 CROWLEY_EMBED_PROVIDER=off full unittest; focused tests for lane schema/migration, lane-aware retrieval, trust defaults, sensitive-lane staging, pattern proposals, and backward compatibility with existing memory_items.
next_action: After V3.9.12 proves packet-in/writeback-out and Mr. Go approves, Codex mints with scripts/codex_sync.py --create-tickets tickets/v4.0_spark_lanes.json.

approval.note: Planned during 2026-07-02 direction pivot. Do not mint until V3.9.12 closes and Mr. Go explicitly approves.

tickets.title: V4 Spark Lanes: schema and migration
tickets.description: Add durable lane/trust metadata for spark-like memory items while preserving existing memory_items compatibility. Support lane, domain, tags, why_keep, worth_reason, sensitivity, and trust_state. Backfill existing rows conservatively without pretending old rows have precise lane truth.
acceptance: Existing memory_items remain readable and retrievable
New spark records can store lane and trust metadata
Allowed lanes are learning, work, relationships, money, health, operating_style
Backfill uses conservative defaults and does not auto-promote old rows
Migration tests cover old and new database shapes

tickets.title: V4 Spark Lanes: lane-aware retrieval
tickets.description: Refactor retrieval so lane/scope is selected before broad memory search. Work/project retrieval should not mix with health, money, or relationship memories unless explicitly relevant or requested. Preserve inclusion reasons and authority order.
acceptance: Retrieval accepts lane and optional domain/tag filters
Default retrieval avoids sensitive lane bleed-through
Broad fallback is explicit and explainable
Inclusion reasons cite lane/scope when used
Tests cover work, learning, health, money, and relationship lane separation

tickets.title: V4 Spark Lanes: trust and approval queue
tickets.description: Add review workflow for candidate sparks: activate, reject, pin, mark stale, or leave candidate. Sensitive lanes (relationships, money, health) default to candidate/review. Promotion to pinned/canon remains explicit.
acceptance: Candidate sparks can be listed by lane, sensitivity, and trust_state
Candidate sparks can be activated or rejected without deletion
Sensitive lanes default to candidate/review
Pinned/canon promotion requires explicit action
Tests cover trust transitions and sensitive defaults

tickets.title: V4 Spark Lanes: pattern synthesis
tickets.description: Synthesize repeated or reused sparks into pattern candidates, especially operating_style patterns. Pattern synthesis proposes memories; it does not auto-canonize. Reuse/access signals should help identify candidates over time.
acceptance: Pattern candidates can be generated from repeated related sparks
Operating-style pattern candidates are supported
Pattern candidates include source spark ids and why_keep
Pattern synthesis does not auto-canonize
Tests cover repeated-spark pattern proposal

tickets.title: V4 Spark Lanes: docs and canon update
tickets.description: Document the V4 memory hierarchy: raw logs -> episodic receipts -> sparks -> patterns -> canon. Update architecture, roadmap, memory hierarchy, onboarding docs, release log, and canon synthesis workflow. Make clear that canon remains manually reviewed high-trust truth.
acceptance: Docs define sparks as the memory unit
Docs define all primary lanes and sensitive-lane rules
Docs describe trust states and promotion rules
Docs preserve raw log / receipt / spark / pattern / canon distinction
Preflight and full test suite pass after doc lock
